title: Planck Time
tagline: A quantum microgame party: five-second games, faster and faster.
description: Nineteen tiny games come one after another, each a few seconds long, each with one verb on screen: measure the qubit, cancel the gates, fix the error. Every one uses only the stick and A. Play alone for a high score with four lives, or side by side against a friend on the same microgames. A one-line caption afterwards says what quantum idea you just played.

keyboard.p1: W A S D to move, B for A, Space to pause
keyboard.p2: Arrows to move, L for A, Enter to pause

how_to_play: Each microgame shows one verb: do it before the fuse burns down.
Every microgame uses only the stick and A.
Solo: four lives, how many can you clear? Versus: the last one with hearts left wins.
Start (Space or Enter) pauses the game.
